name: explainer-punchy
label: Retention explainer, fast list with titles/counters (TheCheapFix, EliYoderSecrets)
_measured: 8 videos: 14-18 true cuts/min, median shot 2.7-3.4 s, p90 5.5 s, nothing >10 s, 1.4-2.7 punch/min (step 42-45%), 60-76% moving, dissolves 14% of boundaries at 0.26 s + glitch/light-leak accents, whoosh on 33-46% of cuts (4.7-7/min), 2.75-6 mid-shot accents/min, tick bursts under count-ups, titles/labels/list numerals with typewriter + fade, count-up '$150 saved' counters on dark plates, solid-box labels, serif/handwritten accents (Eli), archival B&W + vignette + grain (Eli), overlays stay on screen (Eli 52%) or exit on cut (CheapFix 82%), bed -16 to -21 dB at 115-140 BPM, mix -19 to -21 LUFS, first cut at 2.5-4 s

transitions._sfx_placement_rule: MOTIVATED ONLY. Measured 2026-09-07 on 3 channels: reference whooshes sit on 29-36% of cuts but NO measurable signal predicts which cuts -- they are NOT in speech pauses (14/18/13% pause vs 37/25/28% for silent cuts), NOT at section boundaries (43-51% isolated, gaps 2.4-45s), and next-shot duration/motion do not separate them. So we do NOT reproduce the share. A cue is attached only where an editorial reason exists in the plan: a section boundary, or a hard-cut into a beat that carries a graphic landing. Never a bare footage-to-footage cut.
transitions._accents_source: 2026-09-12 glitch research + headless-Chrome pixel verification; selection is content-motivated with spacing, NOT a round-robin (see pick-transitions.mjs explainerSequence)

punch._punch_source: measured 2026-09-07: 809 shots / 3 channels; 20.8-31.1% of shots punched, 2.05-2.38 steps per punched shot

motion._source: measured 2026-09-07: 809 shots / 3 channels / 67 min, every second

captions_modes: sentence-karaoke (full sentence on screen, spoken word highlighted)
overlays._placement_source: measured 2026-09-07: 3163 text events / 3 channels / 67 min; density_per_min intentionally unchanged (see ISS-0006)

music.ask_text: Music bed under the narration? The reference channels all have one (-18 dB under voice); off if you say no.

mix._narration_note: OPT-IN ONLY, never applied without an explicit yes. Measured 2026-09-07: all 3 reference channels crush narration to LRA 2.8-3.3 LU (two also clip above 0 dBFS), which is why they sound relentless. Our standing rule is that narration audio is referenced in place and never reprocessed - a previous loudnorm dynamic-mode pass audibly degraded a real narration. So this is a question at the run-shape step, and the default answer is NO.

look._grade_source: measured 2026-09-07: 809 shots / 3 channels / 67 min, every second

media._photo_note: Photos are what produce the measured zoom-in-photo share (5-15% of reference shots): a still gets a Ken Burns move automatically, a video does not. A pool of 100% video makes that dimension unreachable no matter what motion flags are set. Aim this share when picking per-beat media in Step 3.

_intensity_note: derived by apply-intensity.mjs — normal = the measured corpus band; subtle 45%, strong 155%, off = 0. Planners must read this file, not references/style-profiles.json.
